page.overview:
Who is Dennis McCarthy?

Dennis McCarthy was a Starfleet officer in the 24th century.

In 2328, McCarthy was a commercial transport passenger aboard the ferried him from Midos V Satellite City Spaceport to Murasaki 312. His passenger manifest was accessed by Lieutenant Commander Data aboard the in 2370 by reviewing this data in the commercial transport database. (, okudagram)

In 2365, Captain McCarthy was listed as the commander of the on the Starship Deploy Status chart in the Starbase 173 courtroom. (, okudagram)
